correctness.rationale: Exact normalized Legendre recurrence establishes Lambda_n=1+a S_n+b T_n. For all n>=2, all three displayed rational barycentric weights are strictly positive and add to one for 0<r<1. The 3x3 determinant is positive; thus three endpoint constraints are necessary and sufficient, all higher coefficients positive, and the two admissible vertex checks are exact. Standard sphere theorems yield strictness and C-universality. Finite checker supplements, does not substitute, infinite proof.

value.rationale: The natural signed first-two-harmonic perturbation of the classical ball-Poisson covariance on S2 has a complete two-parameter admissible region with three sharp facets and two finite vertices, despite infinitely many harmonic tests. The high-degree facet uniquely preserves C-universality, while all boundary kernels retain finite-site strictness; this is useful exact information for spherical covariance and kernel design rather than a truncated table.
